name: A BN4 battle started from Lan's room
result: In romlab from power-on (title, NEW GAME, the opening paged), BN4's encounter check patched to return a record started its battle in Lan's room: ACDC Area's first record two Mettaurs at (5,2) and (6,3), 40 HP each; a written record VolGear (80) and Billy (50) at the panels given; enemy 1 with kind 5 a rock. Battles with enemy 1, 3, 5 and 13 alone held 40, 100, 180 and 50 HP, which found the enemy records. The map loader's two literals (0x08028304, 0x0802831C) corrected the first reading of the net's groups (0x80 from 0x02834C), and with it ACDC Area at 0x90.
meaning: BN4's battles can be started and watched at will: the harness the differential's reference will build on. Its group numbering is BN5's (net 0x80-0x94, the large areas 0x90-0x94).
